text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, oseltamivir phosphate is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Current inventory across three sites provides 14.6 to 21.3 days of supply depending on location and strength. Corvale Lakeside has the lowest coverage at 14.6 days for the 75 mg presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include oseltamivir phosphate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for near-term demand but uneven across sites. No national shortage exists. Proactive purchasing from available manufacturers will prevent site-level stockouts.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. for both 45 mg and 75 mg presentations; P&T committee approves formulary addition if required.
2. Buyer places orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as secondary source; P&T committee approves formulary addition if required.
3. Buyer places orders with Alvogen Inc. as tertiary source; P&T committee approves formulary addition if required.
4. Buyer monitors daily usage at Corvale Lakeside and triggers inter-site transfer from Corvale General if days on hand fall below 10; pharmacy director approves transfer.

Not recommended: Delaying purchase until a site reaches critical stock levels.
